findings.title: WriteTimeout is not retried even though Net::HTTP can raise it during a GET request
findings.evidence: The retry list only includes open timeout, read timeout, and connection reset, so a supported transient timeout from Net::HTTP will bypass the retry block and fail on the first attempt.
findings.recommendation: Include Net::WriteTimeout in RETRYABLE_ERRORS, or otherwise document and handle the full set of transient Net::HTTP timeout exceptions that can occur on supported Ruby versions during request transmission.
